messages.subject: Common error: Error in setwd(appDir) : cannot change working directory
parts:
I have several error with this message error: Error in "setwd(appDir) : cannot change working directory"

I have been trying runApp() with my first Shiny App (and others shinys I have been working)  and sometimes and sometimes not show this error message   even if I did'nt change nothing in ui, server neither global .

I don't know if it's a bug or I'm doing something wrong. 
PD: I ran  my Shiny Apps and working well but sometimes give that message... 
I'm using the latest version of R Studio, R 3.0.1  OS: Windows 8

Thank in advance

Arturo Chian

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Common error: Error in setwd(appDir) : cannot change working directory
parts:
It does that if runApp is passed a directory that doesn't exist. This can commonly happen if you use a relative path for the directory, and the working directory changes. When this happens, check the value of getwd() and make sure the relative path is still correct.

If that's not the problem, please let us know.
